name: JAV Playback SDK
notes: Preserves the promoted 1.0.0-test.4 base and mutates only a new Test SDK instance.
Adds self-contained AV01, TKTUBE and JavGuru providers without external Hiker-rule dependencies or hard-coded Cloudflare clearance cookies.
MissAV keeps the Test4 parser while adding last-good domain rotation, missav.to fallback and the historical embed-id HLS fallback.
123AV and Jable resolvers are intentionally frozen in this first expansion test to protect their previously device-confirmed playback chains.
NJAV is intentionally not added because njav.tv currently redirects users to 123av.com and would duplicate the same provider family.
SupJav is deferred because current ordinary fetches are Cloudflare-blocked; no clearance bypass is embedded.
